newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Van Miert declines comment on Telekom.
newsitem.headline: Van Miert declines comment on Telekom.

text.p: Competition Commissioner Karel Van Miert will not comment on the dispute opposing Deutsche Telekom AG to other telecoms companies until discussions with all interested parties are over, his spokesman told reporters.
The spokesman said that Van Miert met German Post & Telecommunications Minister Wolfgang Boetsch on Wednesday and Telekom officials, but declined to give any details on the talks.
"As long as those discussions continue my commissioner refuses to make any comment," the spokesman said. He said that there had also been contacts with the plaintiffs.

A group of six, mainly German companies have complained to the Commission about the coming into force on November 1 of Telekom's new discount tariffs for businesses saying that the conditions put by the Commission for that to happen had not been met.
The uncertainty over the implementation of the tariffs could not have come at a worse moment, as Telekom gets ready for its huge initial public offering.
Commission sources hinted that the Commission would not make any comments that could influence the price of Telekom's shares.

It said this summer that Telekom could not start its discounts before the German government granted two telecoms licences. It also asked Germany to encourage talks between Deutsche Telekom and its competitors on fair access to the infrastructure of the telecoms giant.
